source.title: Long-Term, Stochastic Editing of Regenerative Anatomy via Targeting Endogenous Bioelectric Gradients
source.location: Figure 1A legend; Results text (same paragraph, N = 593)

injury: amputation of pharynx-containing trunk fragment (head and tail removed)

intervention.description: pharynx-containing trunk fragments soaked in octanol solution after amputation

readout.method: scoring of regenerated anatomy under dissecting microscope (eye number and placement)

notes: Percentages (72 / 25 / ~3) from the text converted with N = 593 (text N; legend gives N = 573 with only 72% and 25%, which sum to 97%).
